title: Stellarealm
description: A community-driven survival SMP featuring an emerald-based economy, cross play support, and a long-term no-reset world.
body:
StellaRealm is a public Minecraft Survival Multiplayer (SMP) server focused on long-term progression, community interaction, and a stable gameplay environment. The server runs on Minecraft 1.21.11 and supports both Java Edition and Bedrock Edition players through crossplay compatibility.

The core gameplay experience is survival-based with quality-of-life enhancements. StellaRealm features an emerald-based player-driven economy where users can trade, open shops, and participate in fair market activity. The main worlds are designed to persist long-term without scheduled resets, allowing players to build permanent structures and establish lasting projects.

Additional features include per-player generated loot (including End loot such as Elytra), optional PvP with mutual consent, resettable resource worlds for material gathering, and configurable gameplay options such as phantom toggling. The server maintains a no pay-to-win model — all gameplay advantages are obtainable through in-game effort, trading, or participation.

StellaRealm is moderated to encourage respectful interaction and a community-focused environment. The goal of the project is to provide a stable, balanced, and accessible survival experience without unnecessary complexity.

Java & Bedrock Address: play.stellarealm.net
Bedrock Port: 19132
